instruction.text: Match the figures of speech with their definitions.

atoms.a: This figure of speech compares two things with one another. It is usually used with the words like or as.
atoms.sound: ssml: This figure of speech compares two things with one another. It is usually used with the words like or as

atoms.a: This figure of speech describes one thing as another one without using the words like or as.
atoms.sound: ssml: This figure of speech describes one thing as another one without using the words like or as

trainers.instruction: Is the underlined part in the sentence a metaphor or a simile?

atoms.a: His siblings fight <u>like cats and dogs</u>.
My sister is <u>as brave as a lion</u>.

instruction.text: Match the figures of speech with their correct names.

atoms.a: an exaggeration which is used to emphasise something
when an animal or object is given human traits

trainers.instruction: Choose which figure of speech can be found in the sentence.

atoms.a: Every morning their alarm clock yells at them.
The lights are dancing in the dark.
My eyes hurt from his hideous jumper.
